reviews.title: It's just overall a solid kit for what you're paying for
reviews.comment: Solid cables for what I paid for. Didn't expect it come in a nice box that I could put on display with a nice packaging in side the box for the cables themselves. Since I didn't really read much on the kit itself, everything just surprised me in a good way. Inside the kit was a bag that had all the cables separated in their own bag. Pretty cool idea to be honest. On top of that, each of the cables included 3 cables combs on them, so you can make your cables look clean. Another thing that surprised me was that it also included a smaller bag with extra cable combs, which was a nice feature to have.
reviews.author: Eric Chhay

reviews.title: Awesome cables!  Love em!
reviews.comment: This cables are awesome!  They look and feel high quality!  I would highly recommend them to anyone.  Just make sure you buy the proper set of cables that is compatible with your specific power supply unit.  These are not universal cables for every power supply, so do your research before you purchase.  These are full length set of cables to replace your factory cables, not an extension cables.
reviews.author: Gordon Lindgren

reviews.title: Great cables but double check the amount you get
reviews.comment:
Bought a new set of light blue cables for my RM850X. They look and feel great and were easy to install. A little stiff but once set into place they don't sag. Unfortunately even though I bought a new set, I was missing a the molex cable, 8 pin PCI-e and the 6 pin PCI-e. Don't really care about the molex cable but I ended up having to use the 6pin PCI-e cable that came with the power supply. But now once I upgrade the GPU I don't know if ill have enough cables to use it since I only received the 1 8 pin PCI-E cable.
Overall the cables feel great and will probably just but the single cable when the time comes.
reviews.author: Will
